result.summary: The page is largely well-designed. Excluding the intentional horizontal carousel clipping and bottom viewport cutoff, one minor visual defect remains: the third restaurant card's title is truncated without an ellipsis.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge without a trailing ellipsis, making the full name unreadable and the truncation look abrupt.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis with a single-line clamp so truncated titles end with '…', or reduce the card width / font size so names fit cleanly.
